_what: The detectors do-work/detect-events.mjs can run, and the streams its stream detectors walk. A different detector is a new row in `detectors`: a `program` row names a module of do-work and its export (it answers moments with a time and a strength); a `stream` row names a row of `streams`. A stream's encoder turns the recording into feature frames, its core carries a baseline from frame to frame (do-work/stream-core.mjs) and its heads, rows of their own, say what happened; retuning or swapping a head touches neither the encoder nor the core. `default_detector` is the row used when a run names none.

detectors.note: No weights: the loudness rise and the picture change, ranked by find-action-moments.mjs.
No weights: a running baseline of the loudness rise and the picture change; a frame well above what the recording has been like so far is an event. The heads are rows of `streams`.

sound-and-motion.note: The core keeps a smoothed mean and variance per feature (alpha is how fast it forgets). A head adds its weighted deviations; at z_min an event is made, at z_full it is certain; refractory_s keeps one hit from being many events.
